title: Paired01
tagline: Paired01: Platform to connect with lens profiles on the basis of POAPs and communicate over huddle01.
description:
We used the Lens protocol infrastructure to create and fetch the social profiles. Then we use POAPs to create similar profile groups which can be swiped by users to swap. In the match section, we show existing matches/followers and also showcase possible matches users can swipe right to. Once connected, matched users can connect and communicate over Huddle01 using their digital identities and avatars.



Huddle01 : https://huddle01.com/
how_its_made: Our app is powered by polygon and uses the lens protocol for profile-based interaction, we have also used POAP APIs to fetch the POAPs of the logged-in user, we combined the lens social graph with the POAPs held by a user to provide a custom recommendation to the user, We have used the Profile Module, Follow Module of the lens protocol, for profile creation & the swipe and match functionalities
